title: DeepSeek-V3 joins the text models
summary:
DeepSeek-V3 joined the text API, two personas changed providers, and OpenAI search got more room to answer.

DeepSeek-V3 was added to the text model list as `deepseek`, with generation handlers for DeepSeek’s API and OpenRouter. `mistral-large` and `command-r` were removed from the listed models.

The Midijourney persona switched from Claude to OpenAI, while the Evil persona switched from Command-R to Mistral.

The OpenAI search response limit rose from 1,024 to 4,096 tokens. The delay after both successful and failed text responses changed to three seconds.
